data.name: Timberveil
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Timberveil, a 3D incremental clicker game that takes place deep in a mysterious forest on a living construct.

Chop trees, collect the logs, and sacrifice them to heart to generate revenue for the company. Use your earnings to upgrade your strength and efficiency, or sharpen your axe allowing you to cut down increasingly tougher and more valuable trees.

Slowly work your way up through the company ranks to increase your clearance to visit more of the living construct.

Tunnel through trees to uncover the story, discover loot, and work with the locals and your co workers who will occasionally offer their services (for a price).

Destiny calls, do you embrace it, or defy it?

Timberveil is a game created in a time when I transitioned from a troubled rationalist, to finding god and in that a reason to create and live.

data.short_description: You wake up in a strange place, with a job to do! Chop trees, sell logs, level up, find gear, upgrade it, and uncover the secrets hidden deep in the living construct.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 7
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 4070
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: It will probably run on far worse then this, but this is just what i made it on.
